text: "Boy with Luv" (Korean: 작은 것들을 위한 시; RR: Jageun geotdeureul wihan si; lit. 'A Poem for Small Things') is a song recorded by South Korean boy band BTS, featuring American singer Halsey, as the lead single for their sixth extended play Map of the Soul: Persona. It was released on April 12, 2019, by Big Hit Entertainment. The song's music video was the most viewed online music video in 24 hours at the time, garnering over 74.6 million views within its first day of release. The song was certified Platinum by the RIAA in June. "Boy with Luv" held the record for the song with the most music show wins after the 2000s in South Korea with 21 wins, until the record was broken by "Dynamite". The Japanese version of the song was released on July 3, 2019, on the double A-side single "Lights", via Universal Music Japan. == Composition == "Boy With Luv" featuring American singer Halsey has been described as a "funk pop" song about happiness and love. It is performed in the key of D major with the vocals ranging from F♯4 to B5. It serves as a parallel track to their earlier song "Boy in Luv", released in 2014. According to Tamar Herman of Billboard, the song describes how true strength and love come from finding joy in the smallest things in life. Elias Leight from Rolling Stone classified the song as "nu-disco single". NME characterized it as "bubblegum pop". Yim Hyun-su from The Korea Herald described the lead single as "an upbeat electro-pop song with catchy hooks". According to Refinery29, the light, funk-laced song features live instruments. == Music video == A trailer for the music video was released on April 7, 2019, with a 13-second clip of the song towards the end. The teaser features Halsey working in a ticket booth before walking outside to find BTS sitting on a couch. A second teaser, featuring close-ups of the band, was released on April 10. Directed by Yong-Seok Choi from Lumpens, the full music video was released on April 12. It simultaneously obtained the records of fastest-liked video and fastest-viewed video on YouTube, reaching 3 million likes in 2 hours and 74.6 million views within 24 hours of release, making it the most viewed YouTube video in the first 24 hours after its release at the time, averaging about 860 views per second during that interval. It was also the fastest video to reach 100 million views on YouTube, doing so in approximately one day and 10 hours. On April 26, BigHit released a second version of the music video, titled "ARMY With Luv", dedicated to the band's fandom, ARMY. The video featured footage of the band not seen in the original version and more moments with Halsey; the large "LOVE" sign that appears atop a building while the band dances in the original was replaced with one that spelt "ARMY" instead. In December 2019, YouTube named it the most viewed music video in South Korea of the year. The music video crossed 1 billion views in October 2020, eighteen months after release, and is the band's second to reach the mark. == Promotion == The band performed the song for the first time on April 13, 2019, as the musical guests on Saturday Night Live (making them the first K-pop group to perform on the show) and performed it with Halsey at the 2019 Billboard Music Awards held on May 1, 2019. BTS started their Korean promotion on April 18, 2019, on M Countdown. They performed the song again to kick off Good Morning America's Summer Concert Series at New York's Central Park on May 15, 2019, along with their 2016 single, Fire. On May 15, 2019, BTS performed the song on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert, in an appearance themed after the Beatles' first appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show in 1964. On May 21, 2019, they performed the song at The Voice's finale. On May 30, 2019, they also performed the song at Britain Got Talent's semi-final. ""Spring Day"" (Korean: 봄날; RR: Bomnal) is a song by BTS recorded for their 2017 album You Never Walk Alone, a repackage of their second Korean-language studio album Wings (2016). It was released for digital download and streaming on February 13, 2017, as the album's lead single by Big Hit Entertainment. The song is an alternative hip hop and pop rock track about longing, loss and the hope of reunion. A "Brit Rock" remix version of the track was released for free to SoundCloud on June 4, 2018.

""Epiphany"" is a song by BTS, sung as a solo by member Jin. It was released on August 9, 2018 as the comeback trailer for the group's compilation album Love Yourself: Answer, and appears as the thirteenth track of CD A on the album, released August 24, 2018. Described by Billboard as a "building pop-rock melody", the song's lyrics discuss self-acceptance and self-love. It peaked at number 30 on the Gaon Digital Chart and number four on the US Billboard World Digital Song Sales chart.

"No More Dream" is a song by BTS. It was released on June 12, 2013. It serves as the title track and appears as the fourth track from their debut single album 2 Cool 4 Skool. The song also appears as the first track from their second Japanese compilation album The Best of BTS -Korea Edition- and the second track on CD1 from their first anthology album Proof.

""Dynamite"" is a song recorded by BTS, released on August 21, 2020, through Big Hit Entertainment and Sony Music Entertainment. It is the group's first song performed fully in English. The disco-pop track debuted at number one on the US Billboard Hot 100, becoming BTS' first number-one single in the United States and making them the first all-South Korean act to top the Hot 100; it led the chart for three weeks. "Dynamite" also earned the group their first Grammy Award nomination, and its music video became the group's first to reach 2 billion views on YouTube.

"I Need U" (stylized in all caps) is a song recorded by South Korean boy band BTS as the lead single from their third extended play, The Most Beautiful Moment in Life, Part 1 (2015). The single was released by Big Hit Entertainment on April 29, 2015, in South Korea. It was the first of BTS' career to garner them a win on a South Korean television music show. Two remix versions of the song were subsequently released on the band's first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever in 2016. By September 2016, the song had sold over 800,000 digital downloads domestically. In December 2019, its music video became BTS' 14th to surpass 200 million views. A Japanese version of the song was released digitally and in physical format on December 8, 2015, through Pony Canyon in Japan. The physical single was certified gold by the Recording Industry Association of Japan (RIAJ) that same month for selling over 100,000 copies. The digital single received silver certification in June 2021 for surpassing 30 million streams. In 2019, Billboard ranked "I Need U" as the 80th greatest K-pop song on its list of the 100 Greatest K-pop Songs of the 2010s. BBC named it one of the songs that truly defined the 2010s, referring to it as the starting point where BTS would become worldwide sensations. == Composition == "I Need U" is "an expressive dance track that soars with BTS’ emotive vocals as whistling synths, reverberating hi-hats, and R&B-inspired riffs build upon one another to create a sense of melodic despondency." The song serves as “the start of one’s young adulthood, in which beauty coexists with uncertainty, and focuses on the uncertain future more than the glamour of youth.” The original version of the song is in the key of F minor and 158 beats per minute. == Background and release == The Korean version of the song was not released as a separate single. In Japan, a physical release of the single was announced on November 12, 2015. On December 8, the single was released in Japan through Pony Canyon. The tracklist included two B-side songs that were also Japanese versions of songs from the original Korean EP. Four editions of the single were made available for purchase: a CD-only regular edition that included one of eight collectible photocards (first press albums only); a CD+DVD limited edition that contained album jacket making-of footage; a Loppi/HMV CD+DVD limited edition that included music video making-of footage and an exclusive photo gallery; and a special Pony Canyon BTS SHOP CD-only edition that included one of eight special limited production photocards with a Christmas message on it. Two official remixes of the track were later released on May 2, 2016, on The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever compilation album. == Critical reception == "I Need U" was met with positive reviews from critics, several of whom noted BTS' partial auditory shift away from their classically hip-hop oriented singles and exploration of other genres "towards a more diverse, pop sound" as a turning point in the band's career that laid the groundwork for their future rise to international superstardom and propelled their "momentum further than ever before, with both local and international audiences taking note". Writing for Billboard, Tamar Herman felt the track was "less of a song and more of a revolution", calling it a "milestone of sonic development", and praised the tonal shift in the band's musicality towards a more "ambient electronic-pop sound" as a "representation of their stylistic maturing". Tassia Assis of Clash labelled it a "vital BTS track" that "thrives on a wistful atmosphere of electronic synths and emotional hooks" and "take[s] the listener on a journey that is both exhilarating and moving". "Answer: Love Myself" is a song by BTS. It was released on August 24, 2018, and appears as the sixteenth and last track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer.

"Silver Spoon" (뱁새; also known as "Baepsae" or "Crow-Tit") is a song by BTS. It was released on November 30, 2015, and appears as the sixth track for their fourth mini-album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life Pt.2 and as the eighth track of the CD 1 in their first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever. This song has a Japanese version featured in their second Japanese studio album Youth.
"소우주" (Mikrokosmos) is a song by BTS. It was released on April 12, 2019, and appears as the third track in their sixth mini album Map of the Soul: Persona.

"RUN" is a song by BTS. It was released on November 30, 2015, serves as the title track and appears as the second track for their fourth mini album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life Pt.2 and as the sixth track of the CD 1 in their first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever. A ballad mix and a alternative mix were released on May 2, 2016 and serve as the ninth and tenth track of the CD 2 in their first compilation album. This song has a Japanese version featured in their sixth Japanese single "RUN" and in their second Japanese studio album Youth. The song also appears as the seventh track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

"FAKE LOVE" is a song by BTS. It was released on May 18, 2018, serves as the title track and appears as the second track for their third studio album Love Yourself: Tear and as the ninth track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. A Remixed Version was released on June 4, 2018 as digital single. This song has a Japanese version featured in their ninth Japanese single "FAKE LOVE/Airplane Pt.2" and in their fourth Japanese studio album MAP OF THE SOUL ~THE JOURNEY~. It also appears at the for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST. This song has achieved BTS's first ever Perfect All-Kill (PAK) on Korean charts, BTS Achieves First Ever Perfect All-Kill With “Fake Love” in total the song achieved 62 PAK. iChart™'s Tweet (May 23, 2018) The song also appears as the twelfth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

"IDOL" is a song by BTS. It was released on August 24, 2018, serves as the title track and and appears as the fifteenth track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. A remixed version featuring American-Trinidadian rapper Nicki Minaj was released the same day in the digital version of their second compilation album. Also a stadium remix was released on October 16, 2018 and serves as the third track in their tenth Japanese single "FAKE LOVE/Airplane Pt.2". This song has a Japanese version featured featured in their ninth Japanese single "Lights/Boy With Luv" and the album Map of the Soul: 7 ~The Journey~. It also appears at the for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST. The song also appears as the thirteenth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

"둘!셋! (그래도 좋은 날이더 많기를)" (2! 3!) is a song by BTS. It was released on October 10, 2016, and appears as the fourteenth track for their second studio album Wings and the repackage album You Never Walk Alone.

"Butter" is the fourteenth digital single (second all-English song) by BTS. It was released on May 21, 2021, at 1 PM KST and 12 AM EST. A Hotter Remix was released on May 28, 2021 at 1 PM (KST). Two new remixes, Cooler Remix and Sweeter Remix, were also released on June 4, 2021. Later the song is added as the first track in their first English single album Butter alongside "Permission to Dance". The song also appears and as the eighteenth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof. "Black Swan" is the eleventh digital single by BTS. It was released on January 17, 2020, as a pre-release single for their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7. This song also has a Japanese version featured in their fourth Japanese studio album MAP OF THE SOUL: 7 ~ THE JOURNEY ~ and as the first track on disc two of fourth Japanese compilation BTS, THE BEST. The 'Black Swan' MV reached 18 million views and 4 million likes in the first 24 hours and reached #1 in 94 countries on iTunes within the first 24 hours of its release. @charts_k on Twitter (January 18, 2020)

"DNA" is a song by BTS. It was released on September 18, 2017, serves as the title track and appears as the second track for their fifth mini album Love Yourself: Her and as the fourth track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. A remixed version was released on August 24, 2018 and serves as the seventh track of CD B from their second compilation album. This song has a Japanese version featured in their eighth Japanese single "MIC Drop/DNA/Crystal Snow" and in their third Japanese studio album Face Yourself. It also appears at the for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST. The song also appears as the eleventh track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

""Epilogue: Young Forever"" (also known simply as ""Young Forever"") is a song by BTS. It was released on April 19, 2016, with its music video, as the first single from their first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever, released on May 2, 2016, where it appears as the twelfth and final track of CD 1. It served as the album's third single, following "Fire" and "Save Me". The music video depicts the members running through a maze of fences, interspersed with flashbacks to scenes from the "I Need U", "On Stage: Prologue" and "Run" videos.

"Magic Shop" is a song by BTS. It was released on May 18, 2018, and appears as the seventh track for their third studio album Love Yourself: Tear and as the first track of CD B in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer.

"N.O" is a song by BTS. It was released on September 11, 2013. It serves as the title track and appears as the second track from their first mini album O!RUL8,2?. The song also appears as the third track from their second Japanese compilation album The Best of BTS -Korea Edition- and the third track on CD1 from their first anthology album Proof.

"ON" is a song by BTS. It was released on February 21, 2020. It serves as the title track and appears as the eleventh track for their fourth studio album MAP OF THE SOUL : 7. A remixed version featuring Australian singer Sia was released the same day in the digital version of their fourth studio album. This song also has a Japanese version featured in their fourth Japanese studio album MAP OF THE SOUL: 7 ~ THE JOURNEY ~ and as the first track on disc two of fourth Japanese compilation BTS, THE BEST. The song also appears as the fifteenth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

"Euphoria" is a song by Jungkook of BTS. It was released on April 5, 2018 as the short film titled "Euphoria: Theme of Love Yourself 起 Wonder" and appears as the first track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. The song also appears as the fourteenth track on CD2 of BTS's first anthology album Proof.

"Intro: Serendipity" is a solo song by Jimin of BTS. It was released on September 5, 2017 as the comeback trailer and appears as the first track for their fifth mini album Love Yourself: Her. A full length edition was released on August 24, 2018 and serves as the third track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer.

"Just One Day" is a song by BTS. It was released on February 12, 2014 and appears as the fifth track from their second mini album Skool Luv Affair and the seventh track from their first repackage album Skool Luv Affair Special Addition. The instrumental version of the song was released exclusively physically on May 14, 2014 and appears as the fifteenth track from their first repackage album Skool Luv Affair Special Addition. The song also appears as the fifth track from their second Japanese compilation album The Best of BTS -Korea Edition-.

"보조개" (Dimple) is a song by Jungkook, Jimin, Jin and V (also known as the vocal-line) of BTS. It was released on September 18, 2017, and appears as the fourth track for their fifth mini album Love Yourself: Her and as the fifth track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. The song also appears as the fifteenth and final track on CD2 of BTS's first anthology album Proof.

"Make It Right" is a song by BTS. It was released on April 12, 2019, and appears as the fourth track in their sixth mini album Map of the Soul: Persona and as the third track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7. A remixed version, a EDM remix and a acoustic remix featuring American singer Lauv were released as digital singles. This song also has a Japanese version featured in their fourth Japanese studio album MAP OF THE SOUL: 7 ~ THE JOURNEY ~ and also on their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST.

"Intro: Persona" is a song by RM of BTS. It was released on March 28, 2019, as a comeback trailer and appears as the first track in their sixth mini album Map of the Soul: Persona and as the first track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7. The song also appears as the second track on CD2 of BTS's first anthology album Proof.
"Interlude: Shadow" is a song by Suga of BTS. It was released on January 10, 2020 as the first comeback trailer and appears as the sixth track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7.

"Outro: Ego" is a song by J-Hope of BTS. It was released on February 2, 2020 as the second comeback trailer and appears as the nineteenth track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7. The song also appears as the eighth track on CD2 of BTS's first anthology album Proof.
"Reflection" is a solo song by RM of BTS. It was released on October 10, 2016, and appears as the seventh track for their second studio album Wings and the repackage album You Never Walk Alone.

"쩔어" (Dope) is a song by BTS. It was released on April 29, 2015, and appears as the fifth track for their third mini album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life Pt.1 and as the sixth track of the CD 1 in their first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever. This song has a Japanese version featured in their fifth Japanese single "I Need U" and in their second Japanese studio album Youth.

"Fire" (불타오르네; also known as "Burning Up" or "Bultourune") is a song by BTS. It was released on May 2, 2016, serves as the title track and appears as the tenth track of the CD 1 in their first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever. This song has a Japanese version featured in their second Japanese studio album Youth. The song also appears as the eighth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

"Permission to Dance" is the sixteenth digital single (third all-English song) by BTS. It was released on July 9, 2021. The song was later added as the second track in their first English single album Butter alongside the song "Butter". The "R&B Remix" and "Instrumental" version the song also was added as the second track in their third digital single album Permission to Dance.

"고민보다 Go" (Go Go) is a song by BTS. It was released on September 18, 2017, and appears as the eighth track for their fifth mini album Love Yourself: Her and as the fourth track of CD B in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. This song has a Japanese version featured in their third Japanese studio album Face Yourself. It also appears at the for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST.
"Am I Wrong" is a song by BTS. It was released on October 10, 2016, and appears as the twelfth track for their second studio album Wings and the repackage album You Never Walk Alone.

"Spine Breaker" is a song by BTS. It was released on February 12, 2014 and appears as the eighth track from their second mini album Skool Luv Affair and the tenth track from their first repackage album Skool Luv Affair Special Addition. The instrumental version of the song was released exclusively physically on May 14, 2014 and appears as the seventeenth track from their first repackage album Skool Luv Affair Special Addition.

"욱" (UGH!) is a song by RM, Suga and J-Hope (also known as the rap-line) of BTS. It was released on February 21, 2020, and appears as the twelfth track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7.
"We are Bulletproof: the Eternal" is a song by BTS. It was released on February 21, 2020, and appears as the eighteenth track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7.

"Yet To Come (The Most Beautiful Moment)" is a song by BTS. It was released on June 9, 2022. It serves as the title track and appears as the nineteenth track of CD 1 in their first anthology album Proof.

"00:00 (Zero O'Clock)" is a song by Jungkook, Jimin, Jin and V (also known as the vocal-line) of BTS. It was released on February 21, 2020, and appears as the thirteenth track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7. The song also appears as the thirteenth track on CD2 of BTS's first anthology album Proof.

"Life Goes On" is a song by BTS. It was released on November, 20, 2020, serves as the title track and appears as the first track for their seventh mini album BE. The song debuted at #1 on Billboard Hot 100, becoming BTS' third #1 on Billboard Hot 100. billboard charts's Tweet (November 30, 2020) 1 Also top the Global 200 and Global 200 Excluding U.S. charts simultaneously. billboard charts's Tweet (November 30, 2020) 2 billboard charts's Tweet (November 30, 2020) 3 The song also appears as the seventeenth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.
"Blue & Grey" is a song by BTS. It was released on November 20, 2020 and appears as the third track for their seventh mini album BE.

"전하지 못한 진심" (The Truth Untold) is a song by Jungkook, Jimin, Jin and V (also known as the vocal-line) of BTS, featuring Steve Aoki. It was released on May 18, 2018, and appears as the third track for their second studio album Love Yourself: Tear and as the tenth track of CD A in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer.

"Let Go" is a Japanese song by South Korean boy group BTS. This is the eleventh track in their third Japanese full-length album Face Yourself. It also appears as the third track on disc two for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST.

"Save Me" is a song by BTS. It was released on May 2, 2016, and appears as the eleventh track of CD 1 in their first compilation album The Most Beautiful Moment in Life: Young Forever. This song has a Japanese version featured in their second Japanese studio album Youth.

"피 땀 눈물" (Blood Sweat and Tears) is a song by BTS. It was released on October 10, 2016, serves as the title track and appears as the second track for their second studio album Wings and the repackage album You Never Walk Alone. This song has a Japanese version featured in their seventh Japanese single "Blood Sweat & Tears" and in their third Japanese studio album Face Yourself. It also appears for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST. The song also appears as the ninth track on CD1 of their first anthology album Proof.

"Not Today" is a song by BTS. It was released on February 13, 2017, and appears as the sixteenth track of their repackage album You Never Walk Alone. This song has a Japanese version featured in the seventh Japanese single "Blood Sweat & Tears" and in their third Japanese studio album Face Yourself. It also appears at the for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST.

"MIC Drop" is a song by BTS. It was released on September 18, 2017, and appears as the seventh track for their fifth mini album Love Yourself: Her and as the sixth track of CD B in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer. A remixed version by American DJ Steve Aoki and featuring American rapper Desiigner was released on January 25, 2019 as digital single. This song has a Japanese version featured in their eighth Japanese single "MIC Drop/DNA/Crystal Snow" and in their third Japanese studio album Face Yourself. It also appears at the for their fourth Japanese compilation album BTS, THE BEST.

"Tomorrow" is a song by BTS. It was released on February 12, 2014 and appears as the sixth track from their second mini album Skool Luv Affair and the eighth track from their first repackage album Skool Luv Affair Special Addition. The instrumental version of the song was released exclusively physically on May 14, 2014 and appears as the sixteenth track from their first repackage album Skool Luv Affair Special Addition.

"Dionysus" is a song by BTS. It was released on April 12, 2019, and appears as the seventh track in their sixth mini album Map of the Soul: Persona and as the fifth track in their fourth studio album Map of the Soul: 7. This song also has a Japanese version featured in their fourth Japanese studio album MAP OF THE SOUL: 7 ~ THE JOURNEY ~ and as the first track on disc two of fourth Japanese compilation BTS, THE BEST.

"Anpanman" is a song by BTS. It was released on May 18, 2018, and appears as the ninth track for their third studio album Love Yourself: Tear and as the fifth track of CD B in their second compilation album Love Yourself: Answer.
